analytic_identity.consequence: Positive adjacent basic masses force opposite cross-reduced-cost signs.

probe_theorem.interpretation: The algebraic compressed objective is strictly unimodal, but its maximizer is not always a feasible compressed LP basis. Eight gamma-minus supports have 15 negative basic variables, so the exact full KKT check of the predicted adjacent lift remains necessary.

local_interval_extension.status: certified endpoint-crossing roots; not a complete same-sign root atlas
local_interval_extension.nonclaim: Same endpoint signs do not by themselves exclude an even number of interior roots. A82 therefore does not promote the endpoint scan to a complete interval atlas.

claim_boundary: The complete contact-locator theorem is exact only at s=131/1000.
